test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven workers Rahul, Ram, Ramesh, Sohan, Sahil, Anil and Sonu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Anil is immediate neighbour of both Ram and Sonu. Ram is second to the right of Sahil. Rahul is immediate neighbour of both Sahil and Sohan. Who is second to the left of Sahil?
solution:
Seven workers Rahul, Ram, Ramesh, Sohan, Sahil, Anil and Sonu are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). 

1) Ram is second to the right of Sahil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ee54f2729d67cf0c30336192252a99936c90a28ffcbe2785b25bab58441da16.png] 

2) Rahul is immediate neighbour of both Sahil and Sohan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9792b1980ed1e6d05d6ad2c3068437a166ea90b0df189a17b5feffda9373c932.png] 

3) Anil is immediate neighbour of both Ram and Sonu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1ea7c2feadcbad8fbfa084bd1d51038cfbae5e943f52c17b62c7436d41a9981.png] 

∴ Here, 'Sohan' is second to the left of Sahil.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Sohan".**
